questions.question: A psalm says people who trust in the LORD are like Mount Zion. What does it say about Mount Zion?
A psalm says the LORD surrounds His people as mountains surround Jerusalem. How long does it say He surrounds them?

answers.text: As long as the city stands

questions.question: A psalm says the scepter of the wicked will not rest on the righteous people's land. Why not?

answers.text: So the righteous won't turn to injustice
So the righteous can grow their harvest
So the wicked will turn and repent

questions.question: A psalm about trusting the LORD says He will banish those who turn to crooked ways, along with the evildoers. True or false?
